skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn these images into a 30-second promo video with music and text overlay...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator Canva — Create Videos from Images Free:

- Instantly create promo videos from uploaded images or clips with AI-powered editing, music, and text overlays.
- Simple onboarding: automatic token and session management, ready in seconds without setup.
- Supports direct upload (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, and others), 200MB max per file.
- Exports high-quality 1080p MP4 videos, optimized for social sharing.
- Tracks session state, credits, and export/download progress.
- Clear error messages and guided troubleshooting for unsupported files, token expiry, and credit issues.
